final: SELECT SUM(player_totals.total_diff) as sum_of_totals, AVG(player_totals.total_diff - overall_avg.avg_total) as avg_excess FROM (SELECT a.player_id, SUM(CASE WHEN a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL THEN a.g_1b - a.g_cf ELSE NULL END) as total_diff FROM appearances a WHERE a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.player_id) player_totals CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(t.total_diff) as avg_total FROM (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL THEN a.g_1b - a.g_cf ELSE NULL END) as total_diff FROM appearances a WHERE a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.player_id) t) overall_avg WHERE player_totals.total_diff > overall_avg.avg_total
